messages:
maria: heads-up dashboard p95 jumping on endpoint /v1/generate after rollout tagging change. p50 fine, p99 tiny jump. anyone see sampling source change?

ken: saw alert. could be route-weighting change? rollouts modified route tag merging yesterday.

josh: @ken we merged rollout tags into route metadata — that changed the sampling key for telemetry, might change which traces contribute to percentile rollups.

maria: exact. looks like we lost per-variant sample origin so rollups now blend dedicated + hosted which have diff latency.

sam: is it blending or just misattributing? the p95 jump seems only for model-variant=convex-7b and only for EU region.

telemetry-bot: deploy@canary: canary rollout 2025-06-18T10:12Z -> 10% traffic. commit e3f29

ken: can we repro by forcing origin tag in sampling (hosted vs dedicated)? i can add a temporary tag on the endpoint.

maria: tried adding sample_origin override, p95 goes back to previous. so sampling origin is root cause.

josh: we intentionally switched sampling key to reduce cardinality. trade-off was losing variant origin. maybe add origin back as lightweight label.

sam: weight change + quota routing might amplify effect: dedicated requests go to slow pool under high qps and now counted together.

maria: action: add sample_origin to telemetry key, re-run rollup backfill for last 12h, and add a console note about tag merging. Who owns?

ken: i'll own the code change. will push small PR to add origin to sampling key and a config flag.

frank: UX question — should console show 'mixed-origin' badge when rollups merge origins? ops want clear signal.

josh: agree. propose small UI pill: 'Source: mixed (hosted+dedicated)'. Also add tooltip explaining sampling caveat.

maria: sounds good. ken when you push PR can we feature-flag and enable on staging for 24h before prod backfill?

ken: yes, will do. PR by today. tagging @maria @josh @sam

maria: thanks. also saving current rollup snapshot to S3 before backfill.

telemetry-bot: note: scheduled rollup-backfill job queued at 2025-06-18T13:00Z.

sam: ping if anything weird after backfill. if p99 still moves we'll look at routing quotas.

maria: closing loop — will post results in this thread after staging run.
